name: Farewell Intervale
source:
Late nights, impromptu plans, and the naïve belief that things might stay the same. The hum of sodium bulbs barely hid your snickering as you wandered the empty streets. You made promises you didn’t mean, but were desperate to believe.

That was years ago. Some of you left, some stayed behind, but neither you nor your friends are who you once thought you were, and the world isn’t either. 

Where has it all gone?

[From [url=https://projectulysses.itch.io/farewell-intervale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
深夜、临时计划以及天真地认为事情可能会保持不变。当你在空荡荡的街道上漫步时，钠灯的嗡嗡声几乎掩盖不了你的窃笑。你做出了无意的承诺，但又极力相信。

那是几年前的事了。你们中的一些人离开了，一些人留下来，但你和你的朋友都不再是你曾经以为的那个人了，世界也不再是你曾经以为的那个人了。

一切都去哪儿了？

[来自[url=https://projectulysses.itch.io/farewell-intervale]Itch.io[/url]]
